title: Jarabawar da ke Ƙarƙashin Raƙuman Ruwa
intro: Wani annabi, wanda aikinsa ya ɗora masa nauyi, ya yanke shawara da ta kai shi nesa da mutanensa kuma ta shiga cikin wata jarabawa da ba a zata ba. Tafiyarsa ta ɗauki wani sabon salo, inda ya gwada imaninsa da haƙurinsa ta hanya mafi zurfi. Za ku iya fahimtar cikakkun bayanai game da wannan abin da ya faru daga alamun da aka bayar?
clues: An aiko wani annabi zuwa ga wata al'umma, amma ya tafi da sauri, yana jin takaici da kin amincewa da su.
Tafiyarsa ta kai shi teku, inda ya hau jirgin ruwa mai kaya da yawa yana neman hanyar wucewa.
Babban guguwa ta taso, tana barazana ga jirgin, sai aka yanke shawarar jefa mutum ɗaya cikin ruwa don rage nauyin, bisa ga kuri'a.
Wani halitta daga cikin zurfin teku ya haɗiye shi, wani abin al'ajabi da nufin Allah ya tsara.
A cikin cikin halittar, ya kira Ubangijinsa, yana tuba yana kuma ɗaukaka Allah a cikin duhu.
Bayan tsawon lokaci na addu'a mai tsanani, an jefa shi a kan wani bakin teku mara ruwa, mai rauni amma yana raye, daga baya kuma ya dawo ya ga mutanensa sun yi imani.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Tafiya a cikin cikin babban kifi
trial.answer: Tafiya a cikin cikin babban kifi

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Haihuwa mai ban mamaki ga mutanensa
Masarauta da aka kafa don zuriyarsa
Komawa ga mutanensa waɗanda suka yi imani a lokacin
Nasara a kan wani azzalumi mai mulki
outcome.answer: Komawa ga mutanensa waɗanda suka yi imani a lokacin

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
